direction: Natural contemporary Shanghai photography. Ordinary material details and recognizable gestures with one legible focal point, framed for small card crops. Keep the parents' fictional identities and signature clothes.
delivery: Sixteen opening-card photographs. Two portrait and matching avatar pairs.

public/art/origins/fund-home.webp.label: 家里有套房
public/art/origins/fund-home.webp.prompt: A middle-aged Shanghainese mother's hand pulls open a normal wooden drawer and picks up an old brick-red property document booklet, red cover rotated blank side out, two ordinary brass keys from the same drawer caught in her fingers. Worn scratched lacquer and white cotton sleeve. Morning window bounce, tactile, center red booklet and keys, no identifiable document lettering.

public/art/origins/fund-frozen.webp.label: 副卡被冻结

A cheap paper cup set down nearby. Cashier's small practical gesture, older scratched laminate, real shop daylight. No numbers, readable screens, ads or brand marks.

public/art/origins/secret-dream.webp.label: 想偷偷转行

public/art/origins/secret-poor.webp.label: 朋友圈很有钱

public/art/origins/secret-money.webp.label: 其实存了不少

public/art/origins/secret-kind.webp.label: 悄悄帮过一个人

public/art/portraits/mother.webp.prompt: Preserve this fictional middle-aged Shanghainese mother's face, short softly waved black bob, oatmeal brown cardigan and pale printed scarf. At an open apartment doorway in old Shanghai, natural waist-up to upper thigh portrait. She is slipping a wrapped reusable lunch box into the near visitor's bag with an easy half smile, looking just beside camera at them. Gentle window light through the stairwell, real age texture and worn clothes, she has just remembered to hand over the bag before the adult leaves.

public/art/portraits/father.webp.prompt: Preserve this fictional middle-aged Shanghainese father's face, compact salt-black haircut, slate-gray cotton work jacket and old ordinary trousers. He pauses at the foot of a Shanghai walk-up staircase just after finishing a loose hinge, folding a screwdriver back into his small worn cloth tool roll, looks toward his child off-camera with a dry, quiet smile. Soft reflected daylight across stairs, unretouched working hands and visible face lines, a normal scene, not a photo session.
